COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
13.06.2024 WPSS No. 890 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Nikhil Bhatt, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Atul Bahuguna, learned Brief Holder for 
the State.
3. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for the 
respondent no. 2/Uttarakhand Public Service 
Commission.
4. Vide order dated 04.06.2024 passed by this 
Court, counsel for the respondent/Commission was 
directed to seek instructions in the matter.
5. Today, learned counsel for the Uttarakhand 
Public Service Commission submits that since the 
recruitment process was initiated for Group C posts
by one and the same advertisement for various 
departments of the State in view of the letter dated 
20.11.2017, it is mandated that no waiting list is to 
be issued in such eventuality. 
6. In view of the aforesaid submissions, petitioner 
has failed to make out any case for interim relief. 
7. Respondents may file counter affidavit within 
six weeks. Rejoinder affidavit may file within two 
weeks thereafter. 
8. List this matter on 06.09.2024.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 13.06.2024
Akash
